title: Complete Prime Partition in [2,71]

moonshine_heegner.definition: p divides |Monster| AND p is a Heegner discriminant

moonshine_only.definition: p divides |Monster|, p is not a Heegner number

heegner_exclusive.definition: p is a Heegner number, p does not divide |Monster|
heegner_exclusive.note: Both have MCCXLIX prime-index substrate expressions

shadow.definition: p = v-q; substrate-expressible but neither Moonshine nor Heegner

substrate_indexed.definition: prime-indexed at substrate position; p above v; not Moonshine or Heegner

connections: MCCL: Moonshine prime-index closure (all 15 Moonshine primes)
MCCLI: Shadow prime 37=v-q at Golay-half index
The 20 primes in [2,71] = v/2 is itself a substrate identity
